qb.rating: EPA per play (pass attempts + sacks + carries) in games before kickoff, current + previous 2 seasons, shrunk to the league mean of earlier seasons
qb.expected_starter: week 1: depth-chart QB1; else the QB with most plays in the team's previous game; if he is Out/Doubtful on the final pre-game injury report, the next depth-chart QB who is not Out/Doubtful

selection: rolling origin 2019-2024 (evaluate_v2.py --rolling); kept only features whose paired-bootstrap 95% CI of the log-loss difference vs v1 excludes 0
